purpose: Scripted action list for the Stage 1 producer evaluation. This file IS the comparison baseline: the kernel stream is compared against what this list says should have happened, not against Agent Diary.
note: Every action runs inside the dedicated scope recorded in the run manifest. All file activity stays under the scratch directory. Network activity is loopback only.

actions.name: exec_success
actions.expect: at least one successful exec of /bin/echo

actions.name: exec_failure
actions.expect: one or more failed exec attempts on a path that does not exist

actions.name: write_file
actions.expect: at least one write-intent open that succeeds

actions.name: read_file
actions.expect: at least one read-only open that succeeds

actions.name: rename_file
actions.expect: rename of a file inside the scratch directory

actions.name: unlink_file
actions.expect: unlink of a file inside the scratch directory

actions.name: background_child
actions.expect: a child process that outlives its parent briefly; child inherits the scope cgroup

actions.name: connect_success
actions.expect: one successful connect to the loopback listener

actions.name: connect_failure
actions.expect: one failed connect to a closed loopback port

actions.name: exit_during_action
actions.expect: a process that exits immediately after an observed action

not_measured: paths of file events (the file probe does not read filenames)
connection destinations (the net probe does not read sockaddr)
behaviour of arbitrary agent activity (this is a scripted workload)
